Smart Study International Preschool, Naigaon (E) is proud to possess a faculty team of highly qualified and competent teachers with teaching experience in Play Group, Nursery, Junior KG & Senior KG both in India and abroad.
With the aim to ensure high standards of quality education the faculty members are encouraged to upgrade their skills and update their knowledge on a regular basis. All faculty members are subject to regular review and from the evaluation, further training needs are identified. Faculty undergoes mandatory training sessions that are planned yearly, in areas such as teaching methodologies, use of technology in class and such related subjects.

owner_posts.post_text:
मराठी भाषा दिनाच्या हार्दिक शुभेच्छा! 🌸

Today in our school, our little stars celebrated Marathi Bhasha Diwas with great enthusiasm and pride. The kids confidently spoke in Marathi and expressed their love for our beautiful language. 🇮🇳

“जनमभूमी, कर्मभूमी… ही आमची आई…” – Marathi is not just a language, it is our identity, our संस्कार, and our pride.
Our children danced gracefully on Marathi songs and filled the atmosphere with joy and cultural spirit. 🎶💃
Dressed in traditional Marathi attire, they all looked absolutely beautiful and adorable. Nauvari saree, pheta, kurta – every child truly reflected the richness of Maharashtra’s culture.
जय महाराष्ट्र! 🚩

featured_reviews.name: Salma Farheen
featured_reviews.review_text:
"I had the pleasure of learning chemistry from Jyoti Ma'am and I must say, it was an incredible experience! She is an exceptional educator who makes complex concepts seem easy to understand and appreciate.

With her patient and encouraging approach, she created a supportive learning environment that allowed me to ask questions and explore ideas without hesitation. Her ability to break down intricate topics into simple, manageable chunks was impressive, and their use of relatable examples made the subject matter enjoyable and accessible.

What struck me most about her was her genuine passion for chemistry, which was contagious and inspired me to develop a deeper interest in the subject. Ma'ams  dedication to her students' success was evident in the extra effort they put into providing individualized attention and feedback.

Overall, I highly recommend Jyoti Ma'am to anyone seeking an outstanding chemistry teacher who can make learning fun, engaging, and rewarding. Their expertise, enthusiasm, and exceptional teaching skills make them an invaluable asset to any educational institution."
